sections.body: Welcome to Kizora! These Terms & Conditions outline how we process, ship, and deliver your orders. We've kept things simple so you always know what to expect when you shop with us. By placing an order on www.kizoralifestyle.com, you agree to the terms below.

sections.heading: 1. Shipping Charges
sections.body:
We keep our delivery charges as fair and transparent as possible, based on your location:

● Inside Dhaka city — Tk 60
● Gazipur, Savar & Narayanganj — Tk 80
● Outside Dhaka — Tk 120

Please note that delivery charges may vary slightly depending on the size or weight of the product ordered. Any change will always be shown clearly before you confirm your order.

A gentle reminder: please double-check your order details before confirming. If a product needs to be returned, the delivery charge for the return will need to be covered by the customer.

sections.heading: 2. Delivery Timeline
sections.body:
We offer a few different delivery options depending on how quickly you'd like your order, and where you're located.

**Normal Delivery**
● Inside Dhaka: 24 to 48 hours
● Outside Dhaka: 48 to 72 hours

**Same Day Delivery**
For our customers within Dhaka city who need things a little sooner:
● Available only within Dhaka city
● Delivered between 3:00 PM and 8:00 PM
● Please confirm your order before 12:00 PM via Messenger, WhatsApp, or our hotline
● Delivery charge: Tk 120
● Cash on Delivery, bKash, and other payment options accepted
● This service is not available on Fridays

**Instant Delivery**
For when you need something right away:
● Available only within Dhaka city
● Delivered within 1 to 3 hours
● Please confirm your order before 8:00 PM via Messenger, WhatsApp, or our hotline
● Delivery charge is based on Pathao's rate for your location
● Only bKash payment is accepted for this option

Please keep in mind that delivery times are estimates, and may occasionally shift due to unforeseen circumstances such as weather, traffic, or courier availability. We'll always do our best to keep you updated if anything changes.

sections.heading: 3. Order Confirmation
sections.body: Once your order is placed, our team will reach out to confirm the details before it is processed for delivery. This helps us make sure everything, from product to address, is exactly right before your order is on its way to you.

sections.heading: 5. Changes to These Terms
sections.body: Kizora may update these Terms & Conditions from time to time to reflect changes in our delivery partners, pricing, or service areas. Any updates will be posted on this page, so we encourage you to check back occasionally.
